findings.title: [P1] Restore the required `id` property in the returned `User`
findings.body: Every successful lookup now violates the declared contract. `loadUser` is annotated `Promise<User>` and `export type User = { id: string; name: string }` still declares the required `id` field, but the return statement produces `{ userId, name }` — missing `id` and adding an excess `userId` property. Under TypeScript type-checking this is a compile error (TS2322) on the object literal; in transpile-only setups it compiles but every caller reading `user.id` gets `undefined`. This directly contradicts the PR's stated intent of preserving existing contracts and will bite on every successful call regardless of input.
